source_evidence.scope: Complete engineering article: earlier broad-agent failure modes, approximately 1,300-line orchestrator, deterministic routing, more than 20 workflows, 14 specialists, context isolation, typed handoffs, bounded tools, internal speed and revision results, and publisher-reported limitations.
main_facts: Meta describes replacing a broad agent with a roughly 1,300-line orchestrator that routes requests to 14 context-isolated specialists across more than 20 workflows. The design uses deterministic routing, typed handoffs and narrow tool access. Meta reports much faster delivery and fewer edits, but the results come from its internal engineering environment.

Separate coordination from domain work when one agent’s context becomes noisy. Define explicit routes, minimal handoff fields and bounded tools, then compare completion quality and human revision rates before assuming that additional specialists improve reliability.

OpenAI did not disclose transaction terms or independent outcome measurements, so the announcement establishes direction rather than demonstrated benefit.

Program leaders can evaluate this pattern without coding: choose one disruption, ask for affected studies, milestones and response options, then verify every source and accountable owner. Keep final schedule or manufacturing changes behind named human approval.
